description: This file defines a class 'LeaveEventSubscriber' which subscribes to leave-related events in the OrangeHRM system. It handles event subscriptions and triggers email notifications based on leave events such as apply, assign, approve, cancel, and reject.

classes.name: LeaveEventSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to leave-related system events and manages email notifications accordingly, extending the AbstractEventSubscriber class.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines and returns the array of event types to which this subscriber listens.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns an instance of the EmailService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: onAllocateEvent
methods.description: Handles leave allocate events, determining the type of leave event and queuing appropriate email notifications.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles leave status change events such as approval, cancellation, and rejection, queuing email notifications accordingly.
